component.name: sudo make music
component.summary: Offline AI music generation for mid-range PCs

description.p: Generate songs with a local AI model, fully offline after the one-time model download. Tuned for GPUs with around 6GB of VRAM: long songs are generated in chunks, crossfaded and streamed to disk, with CPU offload, quantization and automatic unloading of the model when idle.
No cloud services and no content filter. The model backend is swappable.
